subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: If If a new PRD ledger entry, technical design document, brainstorm record, or review report is proposed while the switch-over is in effect, including one in a proposal already open at the switch-over, then the system shall refuse it, naming the feature draft as the path
intent: the refusal with the feature-draft remedy
fit_criterion: Every new-document fixture on the released tree, one opened before the release included, is refused with that remedy
